### Shiny example

### What proportion of the earth does my country occupy?

```{r globe}

# install and load the packages
library(sf)
library(rgl)
library(spData)
library(sp)
library(tidyverse)

# Load the world dataset
world <- sf::st_as_sf(spData::world) |>
  ggplot2::fortify(region = "name_long")
  
# Randomly generate a set of coordinates
latitude <- runif(1, -90, 90)
longitude <- runif(1, -180, 180)
coordinates <- sf::st_point(c(longitude, latitude)) 

coordinates = sf::st_point(c(48.85074276916007, 2.3374964820830697))
  
# Use the st_contains function to check if the coordinates are within any of the countries' polygons
result <- sf::st_contains(world$geom, coordinates) 
  
```
